asks: Which tools may a plugin use?
answer: A plugin can use only the tools it declares, and installing it grants them. Which tools Silo offers is settled when they are built. They touch four areas: the record (reading a part of it), opinions (giving one), the app (showing a panel) and the user (putting a question).

sets.means: A view of the record, in the app.
